system.flavor: Slip a grabbing hand and leave your cloak in it, twist out of a rope before the knot bites, or wriggle free of a guard's grip for one step. If he still reaches you, he has you again.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary restraint on you. Response (unopposed): Suppress that restraint during a 1-unit move. It ends if its source no longer reaches you; otherwise it resumes.

surges.html: If you escape, the restraining enemy becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.
